# Northwind Life & Health

Group Extended Health and Dental, Class A

Plan member: [MEMBER_A]

Policy number: [POLICY_1] · Certificate: [CERT_1]

Effective date: January 1, 2025. Benefits are calculated per calendar year. Province of issue: Ontario.

## Paramedical practitioners

| Practitioner | Coverage | Maximum |
|---|---|---|
| Massage therapy (registered massage therapist) | 80% up to $80 per visit | $500 per person per benefit year |
| Physiotherapy | 80% | $750 per person per benefit year |

Massage therapy, physiotherapy and chiropractic share a combined maximum of $1,500 per person per benefit year.

## Vision care

Eye examinations: 100%, one exam every 24 months per person.

Prescription glasses or contact lenses: 100%, to a maximum of $300 per person in any 2 consecutive benefit years.

## Prescription drugs

Eligible prescription drugs are reimbursed at 80% after the annual deductible.

Annual deductible: $25 per family per benefit year, applied to prescription drugs only.

Dependants covered: Spouse: [MEMBER_B]

## Health spending account

Your employer credits $500 to your health spending account each benefit year. Unused credits carry forward 1 year.

## Making a claim

Claims must be received no later than 90 days after the end of the benefit year in which the expense was incurred.

Keep original receipts for 12 months in case of audit.
